first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person F
entities.identification: The short-black-haired person in the foreground on the image-left, wearing a white long-sleeved shirt and a loosely tied narrow red necktie.

entities.name: Person I
entities.identification: The person in the foreground on the image-right, wearing a blue lapel-collared top and a pink knotted headscarf.

entities.name: queue of vehicles in traffic congestion
entities.identification: The multiple light-colored, gray, and dark-colored vehicles on both sides of and behind Person F and Person I, excluding the separately listed Vehicle F.

entities.name: clear blue sky
entities.identification: The light blue sky behind the outlines of the people and vehicles, spanning the upper part of the image.

entities.name: Vehicle F
entities.identification: The dark-colored SUV behind Person I and toward the image-right, with its relatively tall upper body, dark front windshield, and roof rack visible.

entities.name: surrounding crowd
entities.identification: The multiple background people between the vehicles and near the car roofs, excluding the separately listed Person F, Person I, and Person K in this clip.

entities.name: Vehicle E's front door
entities.identification: The dark gray front door of the foreground sedan on the image-right of Person I, with its reflective side window, curved window frame, and side-view mirror visible.

entities.name: Person K
entities.identification: The person whose dark, fluffy hair and side of the face are partially visible in the foreground at the image-left edge near the end of the clip.
